ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Long Hunger
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Ash'karr campaign content: the Long Hunger, a VAST-tier dune leviathan with its own mythos, separate from the (unchanged) Krayt Dragon (SANDWORM_MYTHOS_BUILD_1). Ships RUT_LongHunger (a no-race Building-class world entity per setting_physics.md Part 5's ruled VAST template - erupts, pulses tremor damage, submerges dropping salvage), RUT_Groundcaller (a craftable summoning prop, v1 art placeholder), and RUT_LongHungerContract (the offering quest, mirroring src/RimMandrake/StrandedQuest's proven shape). Design borrowed from chezhou.creature.sandworm (LEVIATHANS:SANDWORM) per research/Jawa/sandworm_krayt_survey_2026-09-02.md; all code here is original, that mod's own ChezhouLib C# is closed/Workshop-only and not used. Uses Anomaly's PitGate texture as a placeholder for the creature's own art. Offline-authored and validated only - no live quicktest yet, see the item file.
